root_cause.text: In `gpiochip_sysfs_unregister()`, the parent GPIO device (`cdev_id`/`cdev_base`) was unregistered before removing exported GPIO sysfs entries, causing `gpiod_unexport()` to fail to find the device association and never release the final reference, leaving stale sysfs attributes.
root_cause.evidence: Commit message states: "once we remove the parent device, we can no longer associate the descriptor with it in gpiod_unexport() and never drop the final reference." Patch moves the loop that calls `gpiod_unexport_unlocked()` for each exported GPIO before the `device_unregister()` calls, and uses an unlocked variant while `sysfs_lock` is held.

agent_logs.evidence_points: Commit message states: "once we remove the parent device, we can no longer associate the descriptor with it in gpiod_unexport() and never drop the final reference." Patch moves the loop that calls `gpiod_unexport_unlocked()` for each exported GPIO before the `device_unregister()` calls, and uses an unlocked variant while `sysfs_lock` is held.

candidates.rationale: Unregisters the parent base device (cdev_base) before the exported GPIO sysfs entries are removed, causing gpiod_unexport() to fail due to missing device association.
Unregisters the parent ID device (cdev_id) before the exported GPIO sysfs entries are removed, breaking the device lookup in gpiod_unexport().
Frees the gpiodev_data structure before the loop that calls gpiod_unexport() on each exported GPIO, making gdev_get_data() return NULL or a stale pointer.
This loop is executed after the parent device has been unregistered and data freed, so each call to gpiod_unexport() will fail to clean up properly.
Call to gpiod_unexport() that relies on the now-destroyed gdev_data; it will return early without releasing resources, leaving stale sysfs attributes.
This assignment in gpiod_unexport() obtains the gdev_data pointer which is invalid (NULL or freed) due to the prior kfree() in gpiochip_sysfs_unregister().
This early return in gpiod_unexport() prevents any cleanup of the exported GPIO when gdev_data is NULL, which occurs because data was freed before the unexport loop.
This iteration uses gdev_data->exported_lines which is part of the freed memory, leading to use-after-free if gdev_data is not NULL but stale.
